scenarios.assumptions: Most cold requests concern different keys; the origin can handle only a fraction of them. What will you do?

concept-specificity.rationale: Applies Distributed Caching to all keys cold.

distinctness.rationale: Separate constraint/decision: A full cache restart creates many distinct misses. Will single-flight save the origin?
